message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Below the title is the text "EDISI 15-21 JULI 2013". At the top, smaller white text reads "INVESTIGASI: NAZARUDDIN DI PROYEK VAKSIN / WAWANCARA PERUSUH PENJARA TANJUNG GUSTA".

The central figure is a woman with short dark hair, shown from the waist up. She wears a sleeveless, shimmering red dress, a red bead necklace with a large teardrop pendant, a silver watch, and a ring. She holds a mask made of dollar bills over her eyes with a thin stick. The bills are folded into a fan shape with eyeholes cut out. To her left, bold black text reads "PEREMPUAN MISTERIUS HAMBALANG," followed by "KPK menelusuri sosok yang dekat dengan keluarga Cikeas ini."

In the background, a multi-story concrete building under construction stands against an overcast sky. Crane structures are visible atop the unfinished frame. The woman sits in the foreground, angled towards the right, with a silver clutch on her lap. A barcode and pricing information are in the bottom left corner.
